custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the dials. Real barometers have precise, evenly spaced numerals. AI often fails here, producing 'alien' symbols or melted numbers. Also, inspect the wood grain; it should follow the geometry of the carvings logically. If the grain blurs or changes direction abruptly at edges, it's a texture anomaly. The lower dial's mechanism is often a point of failure in AI generations—check if the pointer is physically attached to a central pivot.
